phases.name: The Scales Tip
phases.say: You have been weighed. You are found wanting.

say.open: (She holds a feather in one pan of her scales. The other is empty, and waiting.)
say.death: (The scales settle, level, and she nods, as if that were fair.)

bestiary.lore: The card of justice and balance: a judge of the old court who weighs every blow struck against her, and returns it.
bestiary.weakness: Dark. Hold your hardest blows while she counters and reflects.
bestiary.pattern: Every fourth turn she balances (Counter up, Reflect): strike softly then. She marks the strongest with a feather and passes sentence on them; scales silence a row between. At half she balances every third turn.
